title: Unveiling the catalytic potential of silicomolybdic acid in crafting diverse biologically relevant organic compounds
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28783-28804
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03549J, Paper

Neeraj K. Sah, Krishna Kumar, Subrato Bhattacharya, Tanay Pramanik, Tanmoy Roy, Somenath Garai
This study examines silicomolybdic acid's catalytic potential for synthesizing chromene, imidazopyrimidine, xanthene, and benzylidene malononitrile derivatives efficiently.
